sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Tailoring of Licensed Theatrical Costume Robes and Synthetic Wigs

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–United States Double Taxation Avoidance Convention (1994)
France–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (1984) as amended
EU–Canada Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) (provisional application since 2017)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 to L.561-51, L.562-1 to L.562-6, and L.563-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier, CMF), as amended by Ordinance No. 2020-1544 and Decree No. 2021-1; UBO registration is governed by Articles L.561-45 to L.561-49 of the CMF and Decree No. 2019-1251 of 4 December 2019, which created the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs held by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of existence or current extract from the commercial register of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry of the country of origin of the corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and apostilled power of attorney granted by the foreign corporate shareholder to the French incorporation representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copies of the identification documents (passport) of each ultimate beneficial owner and the proposed SARL manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of origin or the issuing passport authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: French translation of the above foreign corporate documents and notarial instruments by a court-certified translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Court-appointed translator (traducteur assermenté) or competent translator recognized in France
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the translation is executed in a non-French jurisdiction; otherwise domestic certification only

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening under Title VI of the French Monetary and Financial Code of all UBOs, directors and authorized signatories against the European Union consolidated financial sanctions list, the United Nations Security Council sanctions lists, the OFAC SDN list, and the French national asset-freezing list issued by the Direction générale du Trésor. PEP status is determined in accordance with FATF Recommendation 12. Screening results must be documented in a compliance file retained for at least five years pursuant to Article R.561-64 of the CMF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des entreprises opéré par l'INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and INPI's company name reservation service
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Latin characters. The legal form designator 'SARL' must appear in the corporate name. French law requires mandatory legal entries to be expressed in French; a distinctive name may contain invented terms or foreign words but must not contravene French language statutes or public order. The name must be capable of being accurately transliterated where a non-Latin script original is used.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of a name rejection by the INPI or the registrar at the guichet unique, the applicant may re-submit the incorporation file with an amended name. If the rejection is based on confusion with an existing registered name or trademark, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Directeur Général de l'INPI within one month of the formal refusal. A judicial appeal may also be brought before the Paris Cour d'appel within one month, or, where rejection occurs during RCS registration, an application may be made to the President of the Tribunal de commerce in summary proceedings (référé) to obtain an order compelling the registrar to record the name. The applicant must attach the original refusal and proof of compliance with prior opposition rectification.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office cannot be used as the sole registered office for a manufacturing company such as a SARL engaged in ISIC 3240 (tailoring of licensed theatrical costume robes and synthetic wigs). French law requires an identified physical address within the national territory at which official notices may be served and statutory books kept. The manager's home may serve as registered office for a maximum of five years under Article L.123-14 of the Code de commerce, and a commercial domiciliation company is permissible provided it is registered as an approved domiciliataire. For production activities, the company must maintain a separate physical facility where actual manufacturing, stock, and personnel are established.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For a low-risk manufacturing entity under ISIC 3240, the estimated probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the French labour inspectorate (Inspection du travail), social security authorities, or tax administration is 25% during the first twelve months following registration, rising to 45% in subsequent years once employees are hired and production volumes increase. This reflects the manufacturing sector profile and the requirement to display tax, labour, and health and safety compliance documentation at the registered office.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and legalization of the SARL articles of association (statuts) by French local counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French law firm engaged by the shareholders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: fixed fee of EUR 1,500–2,500 for a single-member SARL; hourly rate EUR 250–400 per hour

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration fee for SARL incorporation through the guichet unique and commercial court registry (RCS) via INPI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) / Greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official statutory tariff set by ministerial regulation (approximately EUR 83.40 including VAT as of 2025)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the statutory incorporation notice (annonce légale) in an authorized French legal notice journal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized legal announcements newspaper (e.g., Les Affiches Parisiennes, Le Journal Officiel des Sociétés Annonces Légales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official per-line tariff set by the relevant prefecture; normally EUR 95–175 depending on the number of lines

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notary fees for certification of powers of attorney, foreign corporate extracts, and notarial copies of identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French notaire and relevant competent authority for apostille issuance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated notarial tariff for certification (fixed by arrêté); apostille fee under the order implementing the Hague Convention in France

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Translation of foreign corporate documents into French by a court-certified translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-page market benchmark of EUR 40–80; dependent on document complexity and number of pages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration preparation and filing with the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI, with drafting service provided by the legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registration functionality is included in the official RCS tariff; the preparation fee is a market-based lawyer's fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening database checks for all UBOs and the proposed manager
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate service provider or compliance software vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-subject subscription-based benchmark; typically EUR 20–30 per natural person screened

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and comprehensive pre-registration search against the RCS and the French trademark register
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI data-services and the French law firm performing the search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Search fee charged by INPI plus hourly rate for manual legal review; market benchmark EUR 80–120

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce): Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation and operation), L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general company provisions), and L.227-1 et seq. as applicable; Code de l'artisanat Articles L.112-1 and R.112-1 (professional qualification for craft enterprises); Décret n° 2023-312 (single-window electronic formalities); and applicable INPI/RCS NAF codification rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the jurisdiction of the registered office — Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); filings are transmitted electronically through the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) Guichet Unique portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Single electronic registration file ('dossier unique de création': CERFA/Formulaire M0 — Déclaration de constitution de société) accompanied by the signed Articles of Association (statuts) and supporting annexes; registration results in the official 'extrait Kbis' with SIREN/SIRET.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a SARL (freely fixed in the statuts; practical floor €1). Cash contributions must be deposited in a French bank, with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or with a notaire; at least 20% of the cash capital must be released and blocked at signature of the constitutive deed, with the balance payable within 5 years after RCS registration. Contributions in kind must be fully released before signing and remain blocked until issuance of the Kbis.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: We, the undersigned shareholders of FR SARL, acting as the constitutive general meeting and first board of governance, hereby resolve: (1) approving the Articles of Association in the form submitted, with 1,000 fifty-euro par-value shares fully subscribed; (2) confirming that cash subscriptions are blocked in a French bank, at least twenty percent being released, the balance payable within five years per Article L.223-7 of the Code de commerce; (3) adopting the registered office at 14 Rue de la République, 75000 Paris; (4) appointing [Full Name] as sole gérant, invested with the broadest powers to manage, represent, and bind the company and to sign the RCS application and M0 declaration; (5) delegating to the gérant the completion of all registration, publication, tax, and social formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation drafting, name clearance and execution of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The founders (notaire optional; private deed allowed when no real-estate contribution); name search performed on the INPI/RNE databases.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the SARL statuts in French with all mandatory clauses (corporate name, purpose, 99-year duration, registered office, share capital, contribution valuation, gérant powers, shareholder information rights, share transfer restrictions, dissolution rules). Verify availability of the corporate name and relevant trademarks on INPI/RNCS databases. Each shareholder signs the constitutive deed; the gérant signs the separate acceptance of office. If a shareholder is non-resident, arrange for legalized or apostilled identity documents and any proxy powers.
required_dossiers: Acceptance of office by the gérant
Shareholders' identity documents and proof of address
Power of attorney if a shareholder signs by proxy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: No governmental query applies at this stage; if a name conflict is detected, the founders amend the statuts and re-execute the deed; only notarial fees, if engaged, may be partially lost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the provisional bank account and deposit of the released share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A French credit institution, or a notaire/Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations for blocked funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional account in the name of the company in formation (format: 'SARL [Name] en formation'). Pay in at least 20% of the cash capital (full release is permitted). Obtain the banker's certificate ('attestation de dépôt des fonds') stating the company name, amount deposited, depositors, and the release condition upon RCS registration. For contributions in kind, appoint a statutory auditor ('commissaire aux apports') unless exempted under Article L.223-9 of the Code de commerce.
required_dossiers: Company name confirmation and draft statuts
Capital structure and share allocation schedule
Identity of account holders and beneficial owners
Proof of residence of each subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank issues a KYC or business-purpose query, respond with the business plan and complete compliance pack; if the banker's certificate contains an error, the bank will re-issue it at no cost after written correction; the founders may alternatively move the deposit to another institution without losing the company name.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – impots.gouv.fr; VAT registration and filing via Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE); corporate registry via Infogreffe / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must register for a French stand-alone tax identity before commencing taxable activity. Procedure: (1) if non-EU resident, appoint an established fiscal representative acceptable to DGFiP; (2) file a business creation declaration with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (form M0/PR Complet) to obtain SIREN and SIRET numbers; (3) for VAT purposes, submit the relevant VAT registration form (form Montant sur demande, including MOUSA / SF3010 or ca13 depending on activity) to the competent SIE; (4) receive intra-community VAT number (FR followed by 9-digit SIREN) for EU cross-border transactions; (5) where required, register on Chorus Pro for e-invoicing. Steps must be completed prior to any taxable establishment or first B2B invoice.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not operate a check-the-box regime. A SARL is by default subject to corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés, IS). Statutory elections include: (a) option for income tax (IR) under CGI art. 206-3 and 239bis AB for small enterprises (up to 5 fiscal years, subject to turnover and ownership conditions); (b) option for family-owned SARL under CGI art. 239bis A; (c) election for tax consolidation (régime de groupe) under art. 223A at 95% ownership; (d) hybrid mismatch impact per ATAD principles as implemented for cross-border arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT / Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold for non-resident taxable persons: each taxable supply of goods in France triggers mandatory VAT registration from the first euro. For resident SMEs, the small business exemption (franchise en base de TVA) applies for taxable turnover below 91,900 EUR for goods sales (2025 limits) or 36,800 EUR for services, but such exemption is not available to foreign entities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates full B2B electronic invoicing and B2C e-reporting under the 2026-2027 timeline. Large taxpayers must issue and transmit e-invoices from 1 September 2026; all other taxpayers (including SMEs) from 1 September 2027. Invoices must be lodged on the Chorus Pro public portal or through an immatriculated/registered Partner Dematerialization Platform (PDP). The system is clearance-based: invoice facts (issuer, transaction, VAT breakdown) must be transmitted to real-time tax reporting infrastructure for validation and audit; electronic stamping is not used but a digital audit trail with unique invoice ID and certified transmission is mandatory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to physical export of tangible goods outside the European Union provided the seller proves dispatch or transport out of the EU within 3 months (generally 90 days, extendable to one year with authorized proof) and maintains records identifying the goods, commercial invoice, destination, and recipient status. Services physically performed outside the EU or services related to directly exported goods (e.g., export logistics and invoicing services) may also be zero-rated under CGI articles 262-I and 262-II. The zero-rate is denied where transportation is not evidenced, the goods are diverted, or the exporter acts in bad faith. For intra-EU supplies, VAT is exempt under art. 262-I but requires a valid intra-community customer VAT number and summary declaration (recapitulative statement) entry.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Single Administrative Document (Déclaration en Douane, DAU/EXS) with customs proof of exit
Bill of Lading (if sea freight) or Air Waybill (if air freight)
Commercial Invoice issued by the French seller
Inward Remittance Certificate / proof of foreign currency payment received
Proof of physical transport to non-EU destination (e.g., CMR or delivery confirmation)
Export summary declaration and UK/EU Intrastat/Extrastat records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The French tax authorities audit export zero-rating claims with a high degree of scrutiny, particularly for invoices issued to related/related-party foreign entities, split shipments, or quick turnovers. Where fraud or abusive transaction is found: (a) VAT is reassessed at the 20% standard rate alongside a 40%-80% intentional error penalty (CGI art. 1729-2); (b) an additional 100% rate is applied for bad faith or false declarations; (c) interest for late payment is charged from the due date; (d) the taxpayer's VAT number can be suspended and directors can be held personally liable; (e) criminal sanctions for tax fraud under art. 1741 include up to 5 years imprisonment and fines up to 500,000 EUR; (f) export credit refunds are retroactively clawed back and cannot be offset against subsequent tax periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France, as a eurozone member, maintains full convertibility of the euro for both current and capital account transactions under Articles 63-66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU). Cross-border profit remittances by a French SARL are permitted without exchange control approval, subject to mandatory tax reporting and, where applicable, dividend withholding tax at the statutory rate of 25% (reduced to 0% or a treaty rate for qualifying EU majority shareholders under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive). No foreign exchange licensing regime applies to ordinary trade settlements; however, financial transfers exceeding €10,000 (or carrying cash) require declaration to the French Customs and the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistics.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory requirement in France to surrender export proceeds or to convert foreign currency into euros within any specified timeline. Exporters may retain balances in foreign currency indefinitely and use them for any legitimate purpose. For statistical balance-of-payments reporting, French resident companies must report cross-border payments and transfers through the bank intermediary, and periodic declarations to the Banque de France may be required if direct reporting thresholds are triggered. No mandatory conversion ratio applies.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Fintech EMIs (Electronic Money Institutions) such as Qonto, Shine, or Lilo can be viable as an alternative banking channel for a small SARL, subject to ACPR authorisation and passporting rights. A foreign-owned (non-French) EMI passporting into France under PSD2 may operate legally, but the SARL must ensure the EMI holds a valid ACPR or European Economic Area licence. For cross-border payments to China and other Asian suppliers, the EMI may provide efficient multi-currency accounts, but the receipt of online marketplace proceeds (Stripe/Shopify) is facilitated. Viability rating: High for operational processing, Medium for full treasury services (lending, trade finance, FX lines), and the legal constraint remains the absence of a physical branch and the possible refusal by certain French counterparties to accept EMI credentials.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Traditional French banks generally require the legal representative (gérant) or a duly authorised officer to appear physically for the initial KYC interview, either at the bank branch or with a notaire-affirmed power of attorney. Remote account opening is increasingly offered by online-neobanks and certain branchless EMIs, but for tier-1 commercial banks, a physical presence or a videoconference with identity verification via the ACPR-approved PVID scheme is sometimes conditionally permitted. A hard requirement exists to provide the original or certified copy of the company's statutory registration (Kbis), a valid identity document of the manager, proof of business address, and a description of the commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual business pattern - high volume of small online consumer payments (e-banking and card) with export to non-EU jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide authenticated marketplace sales reports (Stripe/Shopify), a list of major B2C customers with countries, commercial contracts, VAT registrations, and the company's organic business plan evidencing low-money-laundering risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Red flag regarding high-risk counterparty jurisdiction (e.g., cross-border supplier payments to China/Hong Kong).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit supplier invoices, import customs declarations (DAU), bill of lading, transport contracts, and documentary evidence that goods are physically received and used in manufacturing (inventory records, production logs, quality inspection certificates).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Identification of directors or beneficial owners as politically exposed persons (PEP) or presence of sanctions-list names.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide explanations of origin of wealth, mediation letters, and a comprehensive list of all direct and indirect shareholders; for PEPs, a compliance-certified clearance opinion from an external AML counsel may be required.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The initial capital injection and subsequent equity or loan financing from foreign shareholders must be routed through SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for interbank) using an appropriate purpose code. For a French SARL, the relevant balance-of-payments (personne morale) code for direct investment is '3501' (direct investment in a French company) or '3502' for loans. The bank will require a copy of the shareholder resolution, the shareholder loan agreement, and confirmation of the ultimate source of funds. Funds must be credited to a French bank account or a EU-EMI account with an IBAN; no exchange control authorisation is required. The funds should be declared in the annual customs statistical survey if the amount exceeds thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlements for imported raw materials (fabric, synthetic hair, etc.) and outbound repayments of shareholder loans can be executed via SWIFT MT103. For enhanced transaction security and when the supplier requests documentary assurance, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (L/C) issued by a French bank may be used. Typical clearing rails for a French SARL include SEPA CT (Credit Transfer) for EU-denominated euro payments, SWIFT MT103 for cross-border currency payments, and interbank payment systems (T2/TARGET2, EURO1/STEP1 for paneuropean). For online marketplace receipts, Stripe and Shopify Payments route authorisations and settlements through their acquiring banks in the EU and pay out into the French bank account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward (EUR/USD, EUR/CNH) - up to 12 months tenor under the ISDA/FX master agreement
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) on restricted currencies (e.g., CNY, INR) where full convertibility for settlement may be unavailable
Cross-currency swap (EUR/USD or EUR/CNH) for matching asset-liability profiles
FX options (plain vanilla and strategies) - subject to the bank's FX risk management policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approved and signed annual financial statements (comptes annuels) with annexes; management report and auditor report (if any) filed at the RCS via the Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (RCS) / INPI via the electronic Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within 6 months of fiscal year-end; filing within 1 month of approval (for a calendar-year SARL, typically approved by 30 June, filed by 31 July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil fine up to €10,000 and criminal fine up to €5,000; risk of court-ordered 'astreinte' and administrative strike-off (radiation) for persistent non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax declaration (liasse fiscale) including result, balance sheet, and annexes; payment of final corporate income tax balance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For fiscal year ending 31 December: return due by 3 May of the following year for online filers; for non-calendar year-end: within 3 months of fiscal year close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty 10% of corporate income tax due, increased to 40% if filing occurs after formal notice; late-payment interest 0.20% per month; minimum €150 penalty if no tax is due; possible tax lien and criminal prosecution for persistent failure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual review and update of beneficial ownership register (RBE) and declaration of any structural changes (share transfers, director changes, registered office moves)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RCS via Guichet Unique; RBE (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed annual filing date; continuous obligation to update the RBE within 30 days of any change. Annual confirmation implicit in the filing of annual accounts and corporate data updates
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to €5,000 for individuals and €15,000 for legal entities for non-disclosure or inaccurate UBO information; potential administrative fine up to €10,000

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) mandatory for SARL if at least two of three thresholds are exceeded: total balance sheet > €4,000,000; net turnover > €8,000,000; average employee count > 50. Also mandatory for SARLs controlling or controlled by companies meeting these thresholds or for public-interest entities
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général – PCG) for individual statutory accounts; IFRS permitted or required for consolidated financial statements of listed groups

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not require a standalone annual UBO confirmation. The company must maintain a continuously accurate RBE and declare any change within 30 days. The annual accounts deposit and RCS information update serve as a de facto annual confirmation of corporate and ownership data, especially where share transfers have occurred during the fiscal year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Registre des titres de capital)
Register of General Meetings and Board Decisions (Registre des procès-verbaux d'assemblées)
Minute Book of managers and shareholder meetings
Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate from 1 Jan 2023; small and medium enterprises reduced rate: 15% on first €42,500 of taxable profit)
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for first €42,500 taxable income (SMEs with turnover < €10M); research tax credit (CIR) 30%; innovation tax credit (CII) 20%; social surcharge 3.3% for groups with tax > €763,000 (turnover > €7.63M)
